intro: Serve requests to /api/subscription from ChatGPT, Claude, Google Antigravity, and SuperGrok plans. Each account shows its own limits and when they reset.

wizard.title: Connect a subscription
wizard.hint: Pick the provider, then the connection method, and review everything before connecting.
wizard.methodSigninHint: Enter a code or confirm; the gateway renews tokens itself.
wizard.methodFileHint: Upload or paste a JSON file from CLIProxyAPI.
wizard.methodKeyHint: Store the key securely in the next step.
wizard.reviewMethod: {method, select, signin {Browser sign-in} file {Auth file} other {API key}}
wizard.reviewHint: Connecting opens the matching form for sign-in, key, and retention.
wizard.antigravityLocked: Set up the Google OAuth client first.

remainingHint: These providers have no account yet. Connect them with the assistant.
connectTitle: {first, select, true {Connect a subscription} other {Add another subscription}}

importFiles.title: Import auth files
importFiles.description: Upload the JSON auth files that CLIProxyAPI or EasyCLIProxyAPI keep in ~/.cli-proxy-api. Codex, Claude, Antigravity, and xAI accounts become subscription accounts. An account that is already connected gets the new sign-in.
importFiles.pickHint: Drop .json files here or choose them. Up to {max, number} files of at most {size} each.
importFiles.chosen: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
importFiles.tooMany: Choose at most {max, number} files at a time.
importFiles.rotation: LLM Hub renews these sign-ins from then on. Stop using the same files in CLIProxyAPI, or both sides invalidate each other's tokens.
importFiles.summary: {outcome, select, success {Import finished} partial {Import finished with errors} other {Nothing was imported}}
importFiles.counts: {created, plural, other {# added}}, {updated, plural, other {# updated}}, {failed, plural, other {# failed}}

timeZoneHint: Reset dates use this zone. Countdown follows the provider's reset timestamp.
stateCount: {state, select, available {{count, plural, other {# available}}} limited {{count, plural, other {# at a limit}}} expired {{count, plural, one {# sign-in expired} other {# sign-ins expired}}} paused {{count, plural, other {# paused}}} other {{count, plural, other {#}}}}
status: {status, select, paused {Paused} available {Available} limited {Limit reached} expired {Sign-in expired} unavailable {Limits unavailable} checking {Checking} other {Connected}}
backInUnknown: Limit reached. The provider did not say when it resets.
expiredHint: Sign in again to use this account.
noLimits: This provider does not report usage limits.

limits.window: {unit, select, hour {{count, plural, one {Hourly limit} other {#-hour limit}}} day {{count, plural, one {Daily limit} =7 {Weekly limit} other {#-day limit}}} month {Monthly limit} other {Usage limit}}
limits.modelLimits: {count, plural, one {# model limit} other {# model limits}}
limits.resetCredits: {available, plural, =0 {No limit resets available} one {# limit reset available} other {# limit resets available}}{applicable, plural, =0 {} other { ({applicable} usable now)}}
limits.none: The provider reported no limits for this plan.

routing.title: Account distribution
routing.description: How requests spread across these accounts. An account at a usage limit is skipped while another still has room.
routing.label: Account distribution for {provider}
routing.group: {group, select, quota {Uses plan limits} simple {Simple} other {{group}}}
routing.method: {strategy, select, inherit {Per model alias} smart {Smart} quota_balanced {Most headroom} quota_expiring {Soonest reset} round_robin {Round robin} priority {Priority} least_inflight {Least busy} other {{strategy}}}
routing.hint: {strategy, select, inherit {Each model alias uses its own load-balance mode from Models.} smart {Spends quota that resets soon and steers clear of accounts close to a limit.} quota_balanced {Picks the account with the most room left on its tightest limit.} quota_expiring {Picks the account whose tightest limit resets first.} round_robin {Takes turns so all accounts wear evenly.} priority {Fills the account with the highest endpoint weight first, then moves on.} least_inflight {Sends each request to the account with the fewest running requests.} other {}}
routing.priorityNote: Weights are set per endpoint on the model groups in <link>Models</link>.
routing.single: Only one account, so it serves every request. With more accounts, this method applies: {method}.

pausedHint: This account is paused and receives no requests. Its limits stay visible.

access.summary: {restricted, select, true {{count, plural, =0 {No key can use it} one {Limited to # assignment} other {Limited to # assignments}}} other {Open to every key}}
access.title: Who can use {name}
access.description: Requests through /api/subscription can reach this account by default. Limit it to companies, departments, projects, people, or single API keys.
access.modes: {mode, select, open {Every key} limited {Only selected} other {{mode}}}
access.nothing: Nothing is selected, so no key can use this account.
access.scope: {scope, select, org {Companies} team {Departments} project {Projects} member {People} key {API keys} other {{scope}}}

antigravity.title: Google OAuth client
antigravity.description: Antigravity sign-in needs the secret of Google's public OAuth client. It is stored sealed and never shown again.
antigravity.label: OAuth client secret
antigravity.hint: Paste the client secret of the Antigravity desktop OAuth client. Without it, signing in is disabled.
